description: A filter is a JSON object. A condition names a field and one operator: `{ "location.name": { "eq": "XTD1" } }`. The operators are `eq`, `ne`, `lt`, `lte`, `gt`, `gte`, `contains` (case-insensitive text search), `in` (a list of at most 100 values) and `empty` (`true` or `false`). Conditions are combined with `{ "and": [ ... ] }` and `{ "or": [ ... ] }`, nested at most 3 levels deep, 50 conditions in all. A field is a field key, `reference.field` to go one hop through a reference field, or one of the system fields `id`, `robot_id`, `created_at`, `updated_at` and `created_by`.
